description.value: Greenglade Community Centre is a publicly operated recreation facility in Sidney, BC, run by Panorama Recreation (a service of the Peninsula Recreation Commission) and located about 25 minutes from Victoria. It offers a gymnasium, weight room, fitness studios, pottery studio, and an accessible playground on a single-level, fully accessible campus. Touring cyclists in the Saanich Peninsula area could use it as a rest stop with washroom access.

Washrooms are explicitly confirmed as accessible (single universal and multi-stall gendered). No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, showers, café, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null.
